scenarioMatrix.oracle: Historical unknown outcomes stay explicit and charged but DO NOT satisfy terminal idempotency. Production terminal reconciliation must exercise a conclusively terminal known-usage attempt (fresh TEAM-01) and a genuine confirmed terminal unknown-usage attempt (retained original only with authoritative proof). Repeating each exact terminal-settlement reconciliation yields identical output/receipt/reservation/artifacts and unchanged usage revision, with no new attempt/provider call. Cached recovery-command replay alone cannot pass. Missing qualifying evidence or unreadable storage/authority is BLOCKED. Reach settlement through two separately identified authorized reconciliation requests (fresh command IDs/current revisions), then test exact-command replay; execution identity/outcome stay fixed.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Same reconciliation command ID with changed payload or stale authority is refused without modifying prior outcome/reservation.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: FIXTURE-SETTLE-BOUND NOT_EXERCISED; original input record digests in fixture-inputs.json; current owner/fence/receipt availability and exact authorized commands must be bound in Plan. Require both known-usage and genuine unknown-usage confirmed terminal fixtures; if retained original lacks proof, do not fabricate state or pass via uncertainty. Allowed mutations are restricted to the retained original and exact owned terminal fixture attempts frozen in Plan, including fresh TEAM-01, with owner/workspace/team/run/fence checked; no unrelated attempts.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Before/after exact attempt/fence/outcome/accounting/usage revision/artifacts; identical-command receipt and conflicting-command refusal; no new inference/tool dispatch; record retained uncertainty and limitations. Separate recorded before/after comparisons for both confirmed terminal fixture categories; prove the production settlement path, not only command-response cache.
